business_problem: Queensland University of Technology needed to attract and retain prospective students more effectively, but fragmented engagement processes and slow responses made it harder to guide people through study choices, enrolment, and lifelong-learning pathways with timely, personalized support.
solution_summary: Queensland University of Technology and Accenture built a student-engagement platform on Salesforce that unifies relationship, data, and AI capabilities for the learner journey. The implementation started with a CRM foundation based on Salesforce Education Data Architecture so QUT staff could capture student interactions from first enquiry through enrolment and alumni engagement. Accenture then added Salesforce Data Cloud and Einstein AI to enrich that profile with faster enquiry handling, personalized recommendations, and better advisor guidance. Because the platform connects multiple systems, lifelong learners can register for professional education without re-entering the same information repeatedly. Advisors use the combined data and AI layer to prioritize outreach, answer questions sooner, and tailor guidance around course choices and student life. The result is a single service ecosystem that combines operational efficiency with more human and timely student interactions.

solution_components.name: Salesforce Education Data Architecture
solution_components.role: Provides the CRM foundation that captures a complete view of student interactions across the learner lifecycle.

solution_components.name: Salesforce Data Cloud
solution_components.role: Unifies student data from multiple systems so staff can act on timely, personalized insights.

solution_components.name: Einstein AI
solution_components.role: Adds AI-driven enquiry management and personalization so advisors can respond faster and tailor support.

data_flow: Prospective-student and learner interactions are captured through the CRM foundation built on Salesforce Education Data Architecture, then unified through Salesforce Data Cloud. Einstein AI uses that profile and cross-system context to support advisor outreach, enquiry handling, and personalized recommendations, and the resulting guidance is delivered back through staff engagement workflows and learner registration experiences.
business_outcome: QUT improved the timeliness and relevance of student engagement, gave advisors better context for each interaction, streamlined professional-learning registration, and created a scalable digital platform that supports enrolment, retention, and service differentiation.
architecture_clues: The CRM platform covers the journey from initial inquiry to alumni engagement.
Salesforce Data Cloud and Einstein AI are used for enquiry management and personalization.
The platform supports cross-system registration without repeated data entry.
QUT later introduced Data Cloud and Einstein AI more broadly for service enhancement.
